en: Vintage sepia multi‑view postcard with decorative floral motifs and a crowned portrait of a woman at the top left. On the right is a view of a wooden bridge or pier leading toward a town skyline with church towers. At the bottom left is a large multi‑storey brick building set among trees and a path, with several people standing in front. Captions identify the scenes as "Nymegen." and "Berg en Dal."
